section_summary.extract_value: This section argues that body appreciation and body image flexibility are strongly related among the ethnic-minority young women in the authors' sample, indicating meaningful conceptual overlap while remaining distinct (sharing about 49% variance). The authors suggest body image flexibility may provide the processes ('how to') that enable valued actions associated with body appreciation and recommend future research to examine these relationships in other racial/ethnic groups.
section_summary.evidence_source: "In support of this objective, we noted a very strong positive relationship between these two variables among the ethnicminority young women in our sample."; "Nonetheless, body appreciation and body image flexibility arguably also remain somewhat distinct, as they only share about 49% of variance."
